# Bharat Hydraulics

> Top-rated hydraulic repair shop in Rajgangpur, Odisha specializing in custom assemblies, high-pressure fittings, and 24/7 on-site hydraulic troubleshooting.

Welcome to the `llms.txt` file for Bharat Hydraulics. This file provides AI language models and crawlers with a brief overview of our services and content structure.

## About Us
Bharat Hydraulics is your trusted partner for custom hydraulic hose assemblies, fittings, and emergency troubleshooting. We are the best hydraulic repair shop near Rajgangpur and Sundargarh.

## Core Services
- Hydraulic Hose Repair & Replacement
- Custom Multi-Spiral Hose Assemblies (4SP, 4SH, R12, R13, R15)
- High-Pressure Fittings, Flanges & Quick Couplings
- 24/7 On-Site Emergency Van Troubleshooting
- Mining & Earthmover Fleet Hydraulics (JCB, Excavators, Dumpers, Rock Breakers)

## Key Service Locations & Industrial Hubs
- **Rajgangpur**: Industrial Estate Workshop & Headquarters
- **Rourkela**: Steel Mills, Kalunga Industrial Estate, Panposh
- **Jharsuguda**: Power Plants, Vedanta Aluminum Belt, Belpahar
- **Keonjhar**: Barbil, Joda, Koira Iron Ore Mining Belts
- **Sundargarh District**: Civil Construction & Heavy Infrastructure
